title: Missing media fails closed
statement: When a narration clip is missing, fail closed: show its text in silence rather than fall back to a synthetic voice.
example: One lesson had 101 of its 177 clips referenced but missing after the voice service ran out of quota.
detail: A plan to recover one course's media, not yet carried out, made its audio packaging fail closed: the builder copies only the clips its manifest declares and rejects absent, duplicate or digest-mismatched ones, and the renderer has no browser speech fallback (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0215-g5-media-recovery-plan-and-edullm-entrypoint-test.qmd`). When the voice service's quota ran out in another build, the standing instruction was that a missing clip renders as silence and captions, never browser speech or a synthetic voice (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0237-u4l2-carbon-copy-build-2026-08-13-to-08-21.qmd`). A silent fallback did slip through elsewhere: three lines with no voice set fell through to the default narrating voice (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0227-g3-branch-hygiene-pr634-prep-2026-09-24.qmd`). Each silent line should also record why it is silent, and no clip that is absent, duplicated or doesn't match its digest should be packaged.
against: A later run found: A Grade 5 release contract allows a synthetic fallback after consent: server audio is preferred, but if it cannot play the browser may read the exact authored text after the same learner consent, and if neither path starts the failure must stay visible, offer retry and leave self-reading available (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/docs/G5_STUDENT_EXPERIENCE_RELEASE_GATE.qmd`, lines 50-55) (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/docs/G5_STUDENT_EXPERIENCE_RELEASE_GATE.qmd`). A later run found: A Grade 5 release gate prefers server audio but, when it cannot play, lets the browser read the exact authored text aloud after the same learner consent; only if neither path starts must the failure stay visible, with retry and self-reading left available (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/docs/G5_STUDENT_EXPERIENCE_RELEASE_GATE.qmd`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/_archive/2026-08-13-consolidation/adversarial-course-council/initiatives/04-g5-media-images-and-narration/HANDOVER.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/docs/G5_STUDENT_EXPERIENCE_RELEASE_GATE.qmd`).
